scientific_scope: Reference-free engineering qualification of the already-selected P2-v1 transient trail-response engagement mechanism. This policy is frozen before P2 runtime implementation and before any P2 simulation execution.

stochastic_engagement_panel.purpose: Verify the dedicated response RNG, per-trial engagement state, exact mixture identity, canonical biology-RNG isolation, and reference-free behavioral reachability of the pre-frozen 20% engineering anchor.

required_structural_checks: For every exact-identity seed, zero dose P2 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and canonical biology RNG state, with zero response-RNG draws and zero trail steering evaluations.
For every exact-identity seed, kappa=0 P2 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and canonical biology RNG state, with zero response-RNG draws and zero trail steering evaluations.
For every exact-identity seed, p_lapse=1 P2 under nominal dose is bit-exact to canonical ant state and canonical biology RNG state, with deterministic disengagement and zero response-RNG draws.

For every exact-identity seed, p_lapse=0 P2 under nominal dose is bit-exact to the frozen P1 local-kernel trajectory and canonical biology RNG state, with deterministic engagement and zero response-RNG draws.
For every stochastic-panel seed at 0<p_lapse<1, exactly one dedicated response-RNG draw occurs and zero canonical biology RNG draws are added.
For every stochastic-panel seed, P2 ant trajectory is bit-exact to the same-seed P1 trajectory when engaged and bit-exact to the same-seed canonical trajectory when lapsed.
The P2 engagement state never changes within a simulation trial.
Distinct ant ids under the same world seed use distinct response-seed namespace values in the qualification panel.
Endpoint reversal, translation, rotation, local steering sign, and on-trail zero-steering invariances of the reused local kernel remain unchanged.
The 400-trial p_lapse=0.20 panel contains at least one engaged and at least one lapsed trial.
Observed lapse assignment count is reported descriptively but is not a fit statistic or pass threshold beyond non-degeneracy.
Mean moving speed remains a diagnostic only and may not be used to tune the P2 mechanism.
implementation_constraints: P2 runtime must extend the canonical integrity Simulation directly.
P2 may call frozen P1 local-kernel helper functions but must not instantiate P1 Simulation as its base class.
P2 runtime may add only the frozen transient engagement state and diagnostics; no Candidate B relative/Weber transduction is authorized.
P2 response RNG must be separate from ant.rng and must use the exact namespaced seed rule frozen in the mechanism record.
No response RNG object or draw is required in exact bypass cases p_lapse=0, p_lapse=1, dose_ratio=0, or kappa=0.
No path-, treatment-, colony-, direction-, or experience-specific response parameter is allowed.
No speed, pause, angular-noise, contact, boundary, apparatus, observation, or scoring logic change is allowed.
No H2-H5 mechanism combination is allowed.
No canonical file may be modified.

result_rule.pass: All required structural checks pass on the exact frozen panels. This establishes implementation/reachability only, not biological fit.
result_rule.fail: Fix implementation defects only. Do not change the mechanism, engineering values, seeds, trial counts, dt, or pass checks in response to reachability outcomes.
